title: ReST-MCTS*: LLM Self-Training via Process Reward Guided Tree Search
authors_zh: Dan Zhang, Sining Zhoubian, Ziniu Hu, Yisong Yue, Yuxiao Dong, Jie Tang
paper_type_zh: 基于树搜索的自训练与过程价值数据构造配方
best_for_zh: 研究 PRM 自举、搜索生成数据、轨迹筛选和迭代推理自训练的读者
one_line: ReST-MCTS* uses value-guided tree search and terminal-answer verification to create positive policy trajectories and scalar partial-solution targets for mutual self-training.
ReST-MCTS* 用价值引导树搜索与终点答案核验生成正向策略轨迹和部分解标量目标，以联合迭代训练策略模型与过程价值模型。
why: For the Data Construction and Open Release Recipes track, the paper exposes a loop from prompt sourcing through tree search, terminal feedback, trajectory selection, value-label inference, and iterative reuse; its flattened public tables also make the missing lineage needed for process-level audit explicit.
inclusion_reason: ReST-MCTS* is an open construction recipe that converts answer-keyed reasoning questions into both selected policy trajectories and search-derived partial-solution value targets, directly serving the Data Construction track's focus on auditable generation, feedback, selection, and release boundaries.

title: Problem
问题
html:
The official NeurIPS 2024 paper and DOI record establish ReST-MCTS* as a self-training method for mathematics and science reasoning. It targets a concrete defect in answer-filtered self-training: a trajectory can reach the reference answer while containing an invalid plan, unsupported intermediate deductions, or an accidental recovery. A terminal match is useful feedback, but it is not dense evidence about the process that produced the answer.

Direct human labeling of every reasoning step is expensive. The paper asks whether answer-keyed questions plus repeated tree search can instead yield two reusable data products without new human step annotations: verified-complete trajectories for policy SFT and scalar targets for partial solutions for process value-model training.

One construction episode contains a question, reference answer, a tree whose nodes are partial solutions with visit counts and learned values, generated next-step edges, completed candidate trajectories, terminal-answer verdicts, and selected paths. This makes the paper relevant to Data Construction and Open Release Recipes: its contribution is a feedback-driven pipeline for generating and selecting data, not merely an inference-time MCTS result. It does not solve independent step verification, decontamination, or general feedback for tasks without oracle answers.

The Card reaches L4 because the official paper and appendix, NeurIPS record, code repository, project page, and public Hub datasets/checkpoint were checked. The evidence boundary remains partial at the release level: public rows are flattened two-column policy or value examples, not raw searchable trees with failed branches and full verdict provenance.

NeurIPS 2024 官方论文与 DOI 记录确认，ReST-MCTS* 是面向数学和科学推理的自训练方法。它针对答案筛选式自训练的一个具体缺陷：一条轨迹即使得到参考答案，中间仍可能包含错误规划、缺乏依据的推导，或先出错后偶然纠正。因此，终点匹配是有用反馈，却不是对生成过程的稠密证据。

逐步人工标注成本很高。论文研究能否在不增加人工步骤标注的条件下，仅依赖带参考答案的问题与重复树搜索，生成两类可复用数据：用于策略模型 SFT 的终点核验完整轨迹，以及用于训练过程价值模型的部分解标量目标。

一个构造 episode 包含问题、参考答案，以及一棵搜索树；树节点是带访问次数和学习价值的部分解，边是新生成的下一步，此外还包括完整候选轨迹、终点答案判定和入选路径。因此，本文属于 Data Construction and Open Release Recipes：核心贡献是反馈驱动的数据生成与筛选流水线，而不只是推理时 MCTS。它没有解决独立步骤核验、去污染，也没有解决无标准答案任务的通用反馈问题。

本卡达到 L4，是因为已经核验官方论文与附录、NeurIPS 记录、代码仓库、项目页、公开 Hugging Face 数据集和模型检查点。但发布层证据仍有明确边界：公开样本是扁平化的两字段策略或价值记录，并不是带失败分支与完整判定来源的原始搜索树。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The central object is a search state, not an isolated sentence. A node stores a partial solution, visit count, and quality value; an edge appends one generated reasoning step; root-to-leaf paths are candidate solutions. The learned process value model and visit statistics decide where MCTS* spends further expansion and rollout budget.

The same searched tree is read through two feedback contracts. First, unfinished branches are pruned and completed answers are checked against a reference by string matching or GPT-4 judging; verified-correct paths become positive policy data. Second, observed reachability of a correct terminal and the minimum observed remaining reasoning distance produce scalar targets for partial solutions, which train the next value model. The process model therefore influences which data are explored before it is used to construct new labels.

This feedback can observe whether the finite search found a verified terminal from a prefix, how far away the nearest observed correct terminal is, and what value the current model assigns. It cannot establish that each retained step is logically valid, that no unobserved correct continuation exists, or that a target stays calibrated after changing the policy, verifier, or budget. Search stopping at value 0.9 is also distinct from later terminal-answer acceptance.

Relative to ReST^EM, the method adds process-value-guided search rather than filtering plain CoT only by final outcome. Relative to MATH-SHEPHERD-style random-rollout process labels, it derives targets from a structured searched tree and observed reasoning distance. Relative to TS-LLM and AlphaLLM, its distinctive data claim is mutual iteration of both policy and value model while using one tree to produce policy trajectories and process-value records. It does not claim to have invented MCTS, PRMs, or final-answer filtering in isolation.

The construction object is richer than the release object. Verified public policy data expose instruction and output; verified value data expose prompt_answer and label. Parent links, visits, competing branches, rejection reasons, and per-example search settings are absent from those tables.

核心数据对象是搜索状态，而不是孤立句子。节点保存部分解、访问次数和质量值；每条边追加一个新生成的推理步骤；从根到叶的路径构成候选解。学习到的过程价值模型与访问统计共同决定 MCTS* 把后续扩展与 rollout 预算分配到哪里。

同一棵搜索树通过两种反馈契约生成数据。第一，剪除未完成分支，用字符串匹配或 GPT-4 判断将完整答案与参考答案核对；核验正确的路径成为正向策略数据。第二，利用“是否观测到可达的正确终点”与“观测到的最短剩余推理距离”，为部分解生成标量目标，用于训练下一轮价值模型。因此，过程价值模型不仅参与构造标签，也会在筛选之前改变被探索的数据分布。

该反馈可以观察有限搜索是否从某个前缀找到了核验正确的终点、最近的已观测正确终点有多远，以及当前模型给出的价值。它不能证明接收轨迹中的每一步都逻辑有效，不能证明未探索区域不存在正确延续，也不能保证换用另一策略、验证器或预算后目标仍然校准。价值达到 0.9 触发的搜索停止，也不同于之后的终点答案接收。

与 ReST^EM 相比，本文加入过程价值引导的搜索，而不是仅按最终结果筛选普通 CoT。与 MATH-SHEPHERD 式随机 rollout 过程标签相比，它从结构化搜索树和观测推理距离推导目标。与 TS-LLM 和 AlphaLLM 相比，其数据层特点是策略模型与价值模型共同迭代，并从一棵树同时生成策略轨迹与过程价值记录。论文并未声称单独首次提出 MCTS、PRM 或终点答案筛选。

构造对象比发布对象更丰富。已核验的公开策略数据只含 instruction 与 output，价值数据只含 prompt_answer 与 label；父子链接、访问次数、竞争分支、淘汰原因和逐样本搜索设置均不在这些表中。

title: Method
方法
html:
Inputs. Initial process-value supervision uses MATH training questions and 11,554 lean-science questions from SciInstruct. The science route extracts prefixes from supplied step-by-step solutions, assumes those solutions are reliable and concise, and treats added ChatGLM2 continuations as incorrect. The math route expands MATH questions by breadth-first search with Mistral-7B: MetaMATH, verifies terminal answers, and derives targets from the resulting trees. Later policy generation uses questions selected from MATH, GSM8K, and TheoremQA training sets; exact item IDs and proportions are undisclosed.

Search state and selection. For each question, a node records (partial solution, visit count, quality value). Selection uses an upper-confidence score combining learned value with visit statistics. The selected partial solution receives a self-critique from the current inference model, either signaling End of Inference or advising further search.

Expansion and rollout. If search continues, the policy samples b next reasoning steps and the value model scores the new partial solutions. The highest-valued new child receives a greedy rollout; at each rollout step, multiple continuations may be proposed but only the highest-valued observed continuation is followed. Its best value updates the rollout node, and a weighted-average backup updates ancestors.

Budget and stopping. Appendix E.2 reports evaluation defaults T=50, b=3, rollout depth cap m=2, alpha=0.5, and end threshold 0.9. The checked code defaults additionally expose a rollout branch count, exploration constant, and temperature, but those code defaults are not evidence for every paper-run release. Exact per-release sampling settings and per-example token budgets remain unknown. A node value at least 0.9 can stop search before reference-answer verification.

Terminal verification and selection. For data construction, unfinished branches are removed. Completed answers are compared with reference answers by string matching or, where learned equivalence judgment is required, GPT-4. The exact GPT-4 revision, complete judging instruction, and error analysis are not disclosed. Verified-correct complete paths become positive SFT trajectories; the official repository distinguishes these positive-only ReST-MCTS*/CoT releases from DPO baselines that also use negative samples.

Value-target inference. In the pruned tree, whether a correct terminal is observed downstream supplies reachability information, while the minimum observed distance to such a terminal represents progress. These quantities are converted into bounded quality values for partial solutions. The initial value model is trained with MSE and AdamW; Appendix E.1 reports learning rate 1e-6, whereas repository instructions list backbone-specific rates that must be reconciled for reproduction.

Mutual iteration. The next policy trains on selected positive trajectories, and the next process value model trains on derived partial-solution targets. Both then generate the following iteration, so the sampling distribution, accepted traces, and targets co-evolve.

Public outputs. At the verified Hub revisions, initial PRM data contain 473,833 prompt_answer/label rows; Llama3 first-iteration policy data contain 33,722 instruction/output rows; and Llama3 first-iteration PRM data contain 673,492 prompt_answer/label rows. These files do not preserve tree topology, rejected branches, visits, terminal-verdict provenance, or per-example search settings.

输入。 初始过程价值监督使用 MATH 训练问题和 SciInstruct 中 11,554 条精简科学问题。科学路线从已有分步解抽取前缀，假设这些解可靠且简洁，并把 ChatGLM2 新增的延续视为错误。数学路线由 Mistral-7B: MetaMATH 对 MATH 问题做广度优先扩展，核验终点答案，再从搜索树推导目标。后续策略数据生成使用从 MATH、GSM8K 和 TheoremQA 训练集选出的问题；精确题目编号与比例未披露。

搜索状态与选择。 对每个问题，节点保存 (部分解, 访问次数, 质量值)。选择阶段使用把学习价值与访问统计结合起来的置信上界分数。当前推理模型随后对选中部分解做自我评议，输出 End of Inference 信号，或给出继续搜索的建议。

扩展与 rollout。 若搜索继续，策略模型采样 b 个下一推理步骤，价值模型对新的部分解打分。价值最高的新子节点进行贪心 rollout；每个 rollout 步骤可以提出多个延续，但只沿观测到的最高价值延续前进。其最佳价值更新 rollout 节点，再以加权平均向祖先节点回传。

预算与停止。 附录 E.2 报告的评测默认设置为 T=50、b=3、rollout 深度上限 m=2、alpha=0.5、停止阈值 0.9。核验到的代码默认值还包含 rollout 分支数、探索常数和温度，但这些代码默认值不能证明每个论文发布都使用相同设置。各公开数据的精确采样参数与逐样本 token 预算仍未知。节点价值达到 0.9 时，搜索可能在参考答案核验之前终止。

终点核验与筛选。 构造数据时先删除未完成分支。完整答案通过字符串匹配与参考答案核对；需要学习等价判断时使用 GPT-4。GPT-4 的精确版本、完整判断指令和误差分析均未披露。终点核验正确的完整路径成为正向 SFT 轨迹；官方仓库明确区分仅含正样本的 ReST-MCTS*/CoT 发布，以及同时使用正负样本的 DPO 基线。

价值目标推导。 在剪枝后的搜索树中，能否观测到下游正确终点提供可达性信息，到这类终点的最短观测距离表示进展。两者被转换为部分解的有界质量值。初始价值模型使用 MSE 与 AdamW 训练；附录 E.1 报告学习率为 1e-6，仓库说明则列出不同的骨干专用学习率，复现时必须核对。

联合迭代。 下一轮策略模型在筛选出的正向轨迹上训练，下一轮过程价值模型在推导出的部分解目标上训练。两者再共同生成后一轮数据，因此采样分布、接收轨迹和目标值会一起变化。

公开输出。 在核验到的 Hugging Face 版本上，初始 PRM 数据有 473,833 条 prompt_answer/label 记录；Llama3 第一轮策略数据有 33,722 条 instruction/output 记录；Llama3 第一轮 PRM 数据有 673,492 条 prompt_answer/label 记录。这些文件不保留树拓扑、淘汰分支、访问次数、终点判定来源或逐样本搜索设置。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The evidence operates at four levels and should not be conflated.

  • Constructed-target fit. The initial value model is evaluated on 14,000 samples with absolute tolerance 0.1 and reports 69.3% accuracy (Appendix E.1). This measures agreement with constructed scalar targets, not independent human verification of every reasoning step.
  • Verifier-assisted selection. On GSM8K and MATH500 with 256 sampled outputs, Table 3 reports 87.5 and 39.0 for self-consistency using the ReST-MCTS* value model, compared with 87.1 and 37.3 for MATH-SHEPHERD. These are solution-accuracy comparisons under one sampling setup; they do not estimate label precision or calibration.
  • Search utility and cost. Figure 2 reports favorable accuracy/token curves for MCTS on MATH and SciBench. Appendix Table 6 reports average runtime per question of 108 seconds for MCTS, versus 41 for CoT plus self-consistency, 43 for ORM plus Best-of-N, and 73 for PRM plus Best-of-N. Input and output tokens both matter, and cost rises with iteration and branching.
  • Iterative training utility. Table 2 reports two rounds across LLaMA-3-8B-Instruct, Mistral-7B: MetaMATH, and SciGLM-6B. The ReST-MCTS* second-iteration averages are 29.02, 26.50, and 35.90, respectively, but individual benchmark cells can decline; for example, LLaMA's first-iteration GPQA score is below its zero-shot starting point. The appendix also reports SciEval subsets where tree search does not beat CoT.
  • Artifact evidence. Official APIs confirm an initial PRM dataset, iteration-specific policy and PRM datasets, and a first-iteration Llama3 policy checkpoint. Verified schemas are two fields wide. Hub license tags are Apache-2.0 for the initial PRM data and CC-BY-4.0 for the checked Llama3 policy data, PRM data, and checkpoint.
  • Sample-level audit evidence. The first visible row in the verified Llama3 policy release reaches the correct final ratio but relies on unsupported geometric claims. This is one example, not a corpus-wide error estimate, but it concretely demonstrates that terminal correctness cannot be treated as proof of intermediate-step validity.

Together, these results support the claim that the loop can produce useful search and training signals. They do not prove that accepted trajectories are stepwise correct, that values transfer to a different policy or budget, or that the public release retains sufficient provenance for a complete data-quality audit.

论文证据分为四个层次，不能混为一谈。

  • 构造目标拟合。 初始价值模型在 14,000 条样本上以绝对误差 0.1 为容差评测，报告 69.3% 准确率（附录 E.1）。这衡量模型与构造标量目标的一致性，而不是对每个推理步骤的独立人工核验。
  • 验证器辅助筛选。 在 GSM8K 与 MATH500 上各使用 256 个采样输出时，表 3 报告“自洽加 ReST-MCTS* 价值模型”的解题准确率为 87.5 和 39.0，MATH-SHEPHERD 为 87.1 和 37.3。这是特定采样设置下的解题准确率比较，不是标签精度或校准估计。
  • 搜索效用与成本。 图 2 报告 MCTS 在 MATH 和 SciBench 上具有更有利的准确率/token 曲线。附录表 6 报告每题平均运行时间：MCTS 为 108 秒，CoT 加自洽为 41 秒，ORM 加 Best-of-N 为 43 秒，PRM 加 Best-of-N 为 73 秒。输入与输出 token 都会产生成本，且成本随迭代数和分支数增长。
  • 迭代训练效用。 表 2 对 LLaMA-3-8B-Instruct、Mistral-7B: MetaMATH 和 SciGLM-6B 各报告两轮结果。ReST-MCTS* 第二轮平均分分别为 29.02、26.50 和 35.90，但个别基准项会下降；例如 LLaMA 第一轮 GPQA 分数低于其零样本起点。附录也报告了树搜索未超过 CoT 的 SciEval 分区。
  • 制品证据。 官方接口确认存在初始 PRM 数据、按轮次发布的策略与 PRM 数据，以及 Llama3 第一轮策略检查点。已核验的表结构均只有两个字段。Hugging Face 许可标签显示初始 PRM 数据为 Apache-2.0，核验到的 Llama3 策略数据、PRM 数据和检查点为 CC-BY-4.0。
  • 样本级审计证据。 已核验 Llama3 策略发布中的第一条可见样本最终比例答案正确，但中间使用了缺乏依据的几何论断。这只是单个样本，不能估计全库错误率，却具体说明终点正确不能视为中间步骤有效的证据。

这些结果共同支持“该闭环能够产生有用的搜索与训练信号”，但不能证明接收轨迹逐步正确、价值可迁移到另一策略或预算，或公开发布已保留完整数据质量审计所需的来源信息。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The paper's concrete novelty for a reasoning-data atlas is the coupling of search, process-value construction, and mutual self-training.

  • It treats a reasoning prefix as a state whose target combines observed terminal reachability and minimum observed distance to a correct answer, rather than copying only a final binary outcome onto every prefix.
  • One searched tree yields two records with different contracts: terminally verified complete paths for policy SFT and scalar partial-solution records for process value-model training.
  • The learned value model is not merely a post-generation filter. It participates in upper-confidence selection, expansion scoring, greedy rollout, backup, and early stopping, changing the explored data distribution before selection.
  • Both generator and critic are refreshed over iterations, rather than holding the critic fixed while updating only the policy.
  • The public recipe exposes enough code and several datasets/checkpoints to inspect the loop, while the flattened release format also reveals which tree-level audit fields are missing.

The nearest comparisons clarify the boundary. ReST^EM filters generated CoT mainly by final outcome; MATH-SHEPHERD derives automated process supervision from random rollouts; TS-LLM uses MCTS with TD-style process values; AlphaLLM also studies MCTS-based self-improvement. ReST-MCTS* is distinctive in its specific distance-aware value construction and dual policy/value mutual-training loop, not because any individual component is unprecedented.

对推理数据图谱而言，论文的具体新意是把搜索、过程价值构造和联合自训练连接起来。

  • 它把推理前缀视为状态，目标同时结合观测到的终点可达性与到正确答案的最短观测距离，而不是把最终二元结果直接复制到每个前缀。
  • 同一棵搜索树产生两种契约不同的记录：用于策略 SFT 的终点核验完整路径，以及用于过程价值模型训练的部分解标量记录。
  • 学习到的价值模型不只是生成后的过滤器，还参与置信上界选择、扩展打分、贪心 rollout、价值回传和提前停止，因此在筛选之前就改变被探索的数据分布。
  • 生成器与评议模型都会跨轮次刷新，而不是固定评议模型、只更新策略。
  • 公开配方提供代码及若干数据集和检查点，足以检查闭环；同时，扁平化发布格式也清楚暴露了缺失的树级审计字段。

相邻工作说明了该贡献的边界。ReST^EM 主要按最终结果筛选生成 CoT；MATH-SHEPHERD 从随机 rollout 推导自动过程监督；TS-LLM 使用带 TD 式过程价值的 MCTS；AlphaLLM 也研究基于 MCTS 的自我改进。ReST-MCTS* 的区别在于其距离感知价值构造，以及策略/价值双向联合迭代闭环，而不是其中任何一个组件前所未有。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
Author-stated scope. ReST-MCTS* relies on oracle reference labels for response filtering. The authors identify generalization beyond mathematics and science, especially tasks without exact answers, as future work. They also note limited value-model scale and data diversity.

Targets depend on policy and search budget. A node value is derived from routes found in a finite tree. Failure to discover a correct continuation does not show that none exists, and the minimum observed distance need not be globally minimal. Changing the policy, branch factor, iteration cap, value model, or terminal verifier can change the label.

Stopping and acceptance are imperfect and distinct. A learned value at least 0.9 can stop search before reference-answer verification. Self-critique is generated by the same inference model, not an independent checker. Terminal filtering then uses formatting-sensitive string matching or an incompletely specified GPT-4 judge.

Terminal correctness does not validate the process. The verified public policy release contains at least one readily visible trajectory with the correct final answer but unsupported intermediate geometry. This single audit example does not quantify corpus quality, but it directly contradicts any assumption that final-answer acceptance supplies stepwise truth.

Initialization embeds label assumptions. The science recipe assumes supplied solutions are reliable and concise and treats ChatGLM2-generated continuations as incorrect. Those assumptions can create false-positive or false-negative partial-solution targets. The reported 69.3% value-model accuracy is agreement with constructed targets, not a human step-validity audit.

Release provenance is incomplete. Public policy and value files are two-column tables. They omit tree topology, failed or rejected branches, visits, search settings, terminal-verdict method, and links between a policy trajectory and its contributing node targets. Exact source mixtures, item IDs, question-level split semantics, decontamination, and benchmark-overlap analysis are not reported.

Licensing and reproduction need reconciliation. Hub artifacts carry Apache-2.0 or CC-BY-4.0 tags, but the official code repository has no visible software license at the verified revision. Upstream question and model terms still need audit. Appendix E.1 reports learning rate 1e-6, while the repository README gives different backbone-specific settings.

Cost grows with exploration. The paper reports 108 seconds per question for its basic MCTS* setup and shows token use growing with iteration and branching. Matched-budget benchmark gains are evidence about the complete inference/training system, not proof that released rows are intrinsically high quality.

作者明确的范围限制。 ReST-MCTS* 依赖标准参考标签完成答案筛选。作者把推广到数学与科学之外、尤其是没有精确答案的任务列为未来工作，也指出价值模型规模和数据多样性有限。

目标依赖策略与搜索预算。 节点价值来自有限搜索树中实际找到的路径。未发现正确延续并不证明正确延续不存在，观测到的最短距离也未必是全局最短。更换策略、分支数、迭代上限、价值模型或终点验证器都可能改变标签。

停止与接收是两种不完美且不同的机制。 学习价值达到 0.9 时，搜索可以在参考答案核验前终止。自我评议由当前推理模型生成，不是独立检查器。之后的终点筛选依赖对格式敏感的字符串匹配，或说明不完整的 GPT-4 判断器。

终点正确不能验证过程。 已核验的公开策略数据中，至少有一条直接可见的轨迹最终答案正确，但中间几何论断缺乏依据。这个单例不能量化全库质量，却直接否定了“最终答案接收等于步骤真值”的假设。

初始化包含标签假设。 科学数据配方假设参考解可靠且简洁，并把 ChatGLM2 生成的延续视为错误。这些假设可能造成部分解目标的假阳性或假阴性。论文报告的 69.3% 价值模型准确率是对构造目标的一致性，而不是人工步骤有效性审计。

公开来源信息不完整。 策略与价值文件都是两字段表，缺少树拓扑、失败或淘汰分支、访问次数、搜索设置、终点判定方法，以及策略轨迹与贡献节点目标的关联。精确来源混合、题目编号、问题级划分语义、去污染和基准重叠分析均未报告。

许可与复现设置需要核对。 Hugging Face 制品带有 Apache-2.0 或 CC-BY-4.0 标签，但在核验版本上，官方代码仓库没有可见软件许可。上游问题与模型条款仍需审计。附录 E.1 给出的学习率为 1e-6，仓库 README 则给出不同的骨干专用设置。

成本随探索扩大。 论文报告基础 MCTS* 设置平均每题 108 秒，并展示 token 用量随迭代与分支增长。相同预算下的基准改善只能证明完整推理/训练系统的效用，不能证明发布样本本身天然高质量。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For the Data Construction and Open Release Recipes track, ReST-MCTS* is useful because it makes a search-generated data pipeline decomposable:

  • Recipe reconstruction: separate prompt sourcing, tree expansion, rollout, terminal verification, trajectory selection, value-target inference, and model refresh.
  • Policy-data experiments: use the released positive instruction/output rows for controlled SFT while documenting that rejected paths and verdict provenance are absent.
  • Process-value studies: use prompt_answer/label rows to study prefix-value prediction, calibration, or alternative objectives, while treating targets as policy- and budget-conditioned rather than step truth.
  • Search ablations: vary iteration cap, branch factor, rollout depth, early-stop threshold, or verifier and measure both accepted-data composition and downstream behavior.
  • Selection-boundary audits: independently check intermediate steps on terminal-correct paths and compare false positives across string matching and learned judging.
  • Lineage tooling: use the recipe as a case study for releases that retain node IDs, parent links, visits, prompts, generation settings, terminal verdicts, failed branches, and rejection reasons.
  • Mutual-training research: test whether refreshing both policy and value data expands coverage or amplifies early errors across iterations.

The verified releases are appropriate for controlled recipe comparison and targeted reuse with additional auditing. They are not a drop-in source of independently validated process truth, and benchmark improvements should not replace checks of labels, lineage, overlap, split semantics, and license compatibility.

对 Data Construction and Open Release Recipes 方向而言，ReST-MCTS* 的价值在于可以把搜索生成数据流水线拆开研究：

  • 配方重建： 分别重建问题来源、树扩展、rollout、终点核验、轨迹筛选、价值目标推导和模型刷新。
  • 策略数据实验： 使用公开的正向 instruction/output 记录做受控 SFT，同时明确淘汰路径与判定来源缺失。
  • 过程价值研究： 使用 prompt_answer/label 记录研究前缀价值预测、校准或替代目标，但应把这些目标理解为受策略和预算约束的信号，而不是步骤真值。
  • 搜索消融： 改变迭代上限、分支数、rollout 深度、提前停止阈值或验证器，同时测量接收数据组成和下游行为。
  • 筛选边界审计： 独立核验终点正确路径中的中间步骤，并比较字符串匹配与学习判断下的假阳性。
  • 谱系工具： 以该配方测试更丰富的发布格式，保留节点编号、父子链接、访问次数、提示、生成设置、终点判定、失败分支和淘汰原因。
  • 联合训练研究： 检验同时刷新策略与价值数据是扩大覆盖，还是跨轮次放大早期错误。

核验到的发布适合受控配方比较，也可以在增加审计后做针对性复用。它们不能直接视为独立验证过的过程真值来源；基准改善也不能替代标签、谱系、重叠、划分语义和许可兼容性检查。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Read a value row conditionally. prompt_answer joins the problem and a partial solution; label is a scalar target derived from search reachability and observed distance. Interpret it together with the generating policy, verifier, and budget.
  • Read a policy row as selected output, not a full episode. instruction is the question and output is a terminally accepted trajectory. The row omits competing branches, node visits, search settings, and the terminal-verdict method.
  • Keep the verified snapshot pinned. Initial PRM data revision 4318a214… has 473,833 rows; Llama3 first policy revision ff8f39c… has 33,722 rows; Llama3 first PRM revision 94eb8649… has 673,492 rows; the official code revision is 2d5f488c….
  • Audit before reuse. Obtain item IDs and source mapping, test question-level split separation and benchmark overlap, retain raw trees and failed branches, log per-example budgets and verdict provenance, independently check intermediate steps, reconcile training settings, and review upstream and repository licenses.

• 有条件地理解价值样本。 prompt_answer 拼接问题与部分解，label 是由搜索可达性和观测距离推导的标量目标；分析时必须同时考虑生成策略、验证器和预算。
  • 把策略样本视为入选输出，而不是完整 episode。 instruction 是问题，output 是终点接收轨迹；记录不含竞争分支、节点访问次数、搜索设置和终点判定方法。
  • 固定已核验版本。 初始 PRM 数据版本 4318a214… 有 473,833 条；Llama3 第一轮策略版本 ff8f39c… 有 33,722 条；Llama3 第一轮 PRM 版本 94eb8649… 有 673,492 条；官方代码版本为 2d5f488c…。
  • 复用前审计。 获取题目编号与来源映射，检查问题级划分和基准重叠，保留原始树与失败分支，记录逐样本预算与判定来源，独立核验中间步骤，核对训练设置，并审查上游条款与仓库许可。
